scope: full unchanged Windows GUI worker, Linux SSH, 100000 official rows, recovery enabled

disk_sampling.method: Linux cgroup and GNU find; PGDATA/base and followed PGDATA/pg_tblspc
limitations: Sequential, non-atomic scans can miss short-lived files or fail during deletion.
Category maxima occur independently; the combined maximum is computed per scan.
Persistent receipts, client caches/staging, WAL and volume provisioning are excluded.
Instrumentation overhead and real Linux calibration remain to be measured.

Measures the whole resource monitor, including memory sampling and Docker calls.
Sampled ephemeral space excludes persistent metadata, client caches/staging and WAL.
metrology_clarification: Filesystem traversal is non-atomic: sums may omit short peaks or combine noncoexistent states. Sampled maximum is not a guaranteed mathematical lower bound.
